invariants.rationale: Null keys list would cause NullPointerException during deduplication.
table is dereferenced in the method, so it must not be null.
Parallelism typically should be positive; used to control concurrency.
All elements in the keys list must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException during getRecordKey calls.
It's common for parallelism to be less than or equal to the workload size; parallelism may exceed size only if the list is empty.
